card.name: Words just before parenteral nutrition
card.fires_on: Small words and word pieces right before the word parenteral or the abbreviation PN/TPN, in parenteral nutrition labels. Examples are on, with, of, receive, called, total.

modes.label: Linking word before PN
modes.description: A preposition or verb that leads straight into parenteral nutrition or PN.
modes.example: In a randomized study of neonates and infants expected to be treated<< with>> PN for at least 28 days

modes.label: Inside the abbreviation
modes.description: Partway through TPN or PNALD, where the next piece relates to parenteral.
modes.example: have been associated with development of PN<<AL>>D.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict the word parent (as in parenteral) next, and away from unrelated words like replacement.
card.plain: It fires on the little words just before the text says parenteral nutrition (IV feeding).
